Reports

Say it in Greek: Καλημέρα σε όλους τους φίλους μας and go on.

Ευχαριστώ πολύ για τη βοήθεια σας

Σήμερα έχουμε πολύ καλό καιρό

The word Ελληνικά alone is a name, not a phrase.

Two words: Καλή μέρα.

The cat sat on the mat. The dog ran to the car. We all had fun in the sun. It was a good day for us. The kids ate hot food and went out to play. Then they came home and had a nap. Mom and Dad read to them in bed. The sun went down and the moon came up. All was well in the town. The next day was just as nice, so they went to the lake to swim and fish for a while.
